author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Actual vehicle draw/atlas CPU contract checks with deliberately unsorted synthetic parts; production race/plant sync already sorts glass last, trailer uploads do not. GPU compile and matched visual captures remain required

checks.name: candidate includes the exact current vehicle shader
all code outside vehicle renderer and existing livery atlas remains identical
every existing vehicle material and mesh part still draws exactly once
existing transforms, steering, brake, livery, colours and quality uniforms are unchanged
surface semantic is set independently for every draw without leaking from earlier parts
all opaque vehicle parts draw before glass and glass follows the opaque cockpit
glass preserves premultiplied blending without writing depth
decals and emissive panels follow glazing without losing alpha or source colour
opaque paint and tyres retain depth writes and disabled blending
existing high-speed spoke fade still suppresses the same draw
night and baseline detail paths bind their own unchanged look uniforms
trailer keeps all four draws while placing shell and tyre before glazing
trailer hitch/wheel matrices and brake values remain unchanged
original livery pixels and atlas dimensions remain exactly identical
atlas minification uses the generated mip chain while magnification stays linear
same-context atlas reuse allocates and generates only once
a fresh restored/mounted context generates its own texture and mip chain
single-channel mip overhead fits the stated 174763-byte budget
shader retains one existing atlas sampler and one bounded environment lookup
normal derivatives and roughness filtering precede divergent material branches
shader keeps livery masks and glyph sampling without adding vehicle vertex attributes
